stem.en: Painted lines are ______, but many people do not feel safe using them.

why.en: "Painted lines are cheap, but many people still don't feel safe using them."
why.uz: «Painted lines are cheap, but many people still don’t feel safe using them» — arzon, lekin xavfsiz emas.
why.ru: «Painted lines are cheap, but many people still don't feel safe using them» — дёшево, но небезопасно.

stem.en: The lecturer calls the imaginary town ______.

why.en: "Let's imagine a town of about fifty thousand people. I'll call it Eastbrook."
why.uz: «I’ll call it Eastbrook» — xayoliy shaharning nomi.
why.ru: «I'll call it Eastbrook» — так назван воображаемый город.

stem.en: Before the changes, the council counted ______ cyclists a day on the main bridge.

why.en: "The council counted three hundred cyclists a day on the main bridge before the changes." Nine hundred came later.
why.uz: «Counted three hundred cyclists a day ... before the changes». Toʻqqiz yuz — keyinroq.
why.ru: «Counted three hundred cyclists a day ... before the changes». Девятьсот — позже.

stem.en: In the example, the number of cyclists on the bridge rose to ______ a day.

why.en: Three hundred was the count before the changes; "if the count rose to nine hundred two years later".
why.uz: Oʻzgarishlardan oldin uch yuz edi; «if the count rose to nine hundred two years later».
why.ru: До изменений было триста; «if the count rose to nine hundred two years later».
